title: OneHundo Orthogonal State Dimensions & Core Enums
description: Canonical definitions for the four orthogonal state dimensions, ingestion planes, and runtime lifecycle signals.

ingestion_plane.description: The ingestion plane producing the data (Plane A, B, or C).

trust_tier.description: Orthogonal Dimension 2: Trust level of the runtime integration and environment.

evidence_class.description: Orthogonal Dimension 3: Provenance class of the achievement or stat evidence.

lifecycle_signal.description: Explicit Plane A frame lifecycle signal.

receipt_status.description: Durable transport receipt status (distinct from acceptance_status).

acceptance_status.description: Platform verification acceptance outcome (distinct from receipt_status).
